name: Avatar
label: Avatar
description: A person's or an organisation's image, with initials and icon fallback, a status indicator, and multiple sizes.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alt text for the image, also the avatar's accessible name. A passed `aria-label` takes precedence. An organisation's avatar (`shape="square"`) should pass it, or it is announced as a user's.

props.name: name
props.description: User's name — used for initials fallback

props.name: shape
props.description: `circle` for a person; `square` for an organisation (a company, a bank, a vendor, an integration): rounded corners on the radius scale, a logo fitted whole rather than cropped, and a building glyph when there is no image or name.

props.name: fill
props.description:
Which of the six fills the initials sit on. Picked from the name when
unset, so a person keeps one colour everywhere; `neutral` keeps the
plain grey. An AvatarGroup
sets it on its avatars so neighbours in the stack differ.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the status dot. Defaults to the `status` value itself (e.g. "online").

AvatarFill.description: One of the six avatar fills, by token number (`--color-avatar-bg-*`).
